$description: Which contract addresses the Dwarves estate treats as live. Generated from a private registry; do not edit by hand. Every field here is public chain data.
$fingerprint_recipe: First 32 hex chars of the sha256 over the ASCII JSON-RPC result string of eth_getCode(address,'latest'), 0x prefix included. Truncated deliberately: 128 bits is far more than a drift check needs, and an untruncated digest trips the secret-guard hook on every write. Reproduce: curl -s -X POST $RPC -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<addr>","latest"]}' | jq -r .result | tr -d '\n' | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-32
